title: Session
description: A plugin session — one problem being worked through /argus:clarify → :team → :verify → :boss → :revise. Stored as .argus/sessions/{id}/session.json. Scoped for plugin-native filesystem persistence.

id.description: Session ID (slug-safe, human-readable preferred over UUID for directory naming).

repo_path.description: Absolute path to the repo this session belongs to. Plugin uses this for code-native context.

repo_branch.description: Git branch at session start. Helps recover context.

invoking_context.description: What the user was working on when they invoked argus.

target_ref.description: PR#, file path, branch name, etc.

boss_agent.description: Configured Boss for this session. Pulled from .argus/config.yaml.

phase.description: Plugin phase. Verification is first-class: team output becomes a candidate until /argus:verify marks what is supported, challenged, or blocked.

snapshots.description: All snapshots from /argus:clarify rounds. Latest is authoritative.

classification.description: Output of /argus:team classification step. May be partially populated by /argus:sail Step 6b (user-confirmed stakes) before team runs.

stakes_confidence.description: Confidence in stakes assignment. <75 triggers sail Step 6b AskUserQuestion. 100 means user-confirmed.

stakes_user_confirmed.description: True when sail Step 6b ran and the user explicitly chose the stakes level. When true, /argus:team Step 2 must NOT re-classify stakes — only fill steps_classified.

drafts.description: Version tree of completed drafts. drafts[0] = root of tree.
